name: Feral Hearts
source: The lifestyles of the rich and famous aren't always glitter and gold, but you're determined to shine. As an inexperienced PR assistant-turned-agent, can you manage four of Tokyo’s hottest heartthrobs while your boss is out sick, or will everyone be howling from your mistakes? No matter what wildness ensues, they’re trusting you with their lives… and hearts!
translation: 名流富豪的生活并不总是金光闪耀，但你仍决心闯出一片天地。作为一名经验不足、刚从公关助理转任经纪人的新人，在老板病假期间，你能管理好东京最炙手可热的四位万人迷吗？还是会因接连犯错，让所有人都哀号不已？无论事态变得多么疯狂，他们都把人生……还有真心，托付给了你！
